description: This file defines the CategoryDBUtil class which provides database utility methods for managing Category entities, including fetching all categories, inserting new ones, updating existing categories, and deleting categories from the database.
external_files: webDB (assumed as a utility for database operations)

classes.name: CategoryDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class that performs CRUD operations on Category data in the database.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Fetches all category records from the database and returns a list of Category objects.

methods.name: insertCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database and associates it with an employee ID.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing category identified by its CID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category from the database based on its CID.
